task.instruction: Find out how much more package storage the Enterprise version has over Team in GitHub Pricing.

final_answer: According to GitHub's pricing page (GitHub Packages section), the Team plan includes 2GB of Packages storage, while the Enterprise plan includes 50GB. That means Enterprise gives you 48GB more package storage than Team — 25× the amount. (For reference, Free is 500MB.)

judge.rationale: The pricing page text shows Team has 2GB Packages storage and Enterprise has 50GB, supporting the agent’s 48GB difference.
